Accessible, inclusive subtitled/captioned shows enable film fans with hearing loss to ENJOY rather than endure cinema. For a few hours, the disabling barrier is removed. They provide social benefits such as equality, inclusion and community integration. Almost a million admissions to accessible shows annually!
